description: Recorded utterance corpus for latency baselines and STT accuracy comparison. Sample rate 16 kHz, mono, 16-bit PCM WAV.

categories.short_command: Crisp, quickly-ended requests. Establishes the fast-path floor.
categories.thoughtful_pause: Longer speech containing genuine mid-sentence pauses. These decide whether a shorter VAD silence window truncates real speech - a corpus without them makes any reduction look safe.
categories.noisy_room: Recorded with realistic background noise. Guards against tuning that only holds in a silent room.
